title: Sysconfig.expand_makefile_vars is deprecated
summary: Python 3.14 deprecates sysconfig.expand_makefile_vars, to be removed in Python 3.16.

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of sysconfig.expand_makefile_vars with the vars argument of sysconfig.get_paths().

verification.purpose: Run the tests with deprecation warnings as errors when pytest is used.
